# Copilot Repository Instructions

## Non-negotiable: never fork the implementation

Do not create a repository fork, branch, worktree, parallel commit lineage, duplicate component, “V2,” alternate command path, or disconnected implementation to avoid integrating with current work. Work in the existing checkout and shared history. Build on the authoritative solution, replace it completely, or delete it and repair callers. Reconcile conflicts by testing both ideas, merging the best compatible behavior, choosing one owner, and removing the superseded path.

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` in full before making any repository change. It is the authoritative operating standard for synchronization, ownership, testing, truthful status, asset provenance, commits, publication, and cleanup.
